newsitem.title: UK: Allders warns on H2 sales growth outlook.
newsitem.headline: Allders warns on H2 sales growth outlook.

text.p: British retailer Allders Plc said on Wednesday its second half had started well, although it added that it was unlikely the first half's high rate of sales growth could be maintained.
The company said like-for-like sales grew 7.2 percent in the seven weeks to May 17, equivalent to 10.1 percent if the effect of a mid-season sale was excluded.
Like-for-like sales rose 13.3 percent in the first half ended on March 31.

"The sustained recovery of confidence in the UK retail sector has now continued for more than 12 months, suggesting that the high rate of sales growth generated by the group in the first half of this financial year is unlikely to be maintained," Allders said in its first-half earnings statement.
It added that the new Labour Government's interim budget, along with the potential of further interest rate rises, might produce some uncertainty among consumers.
Allders' first-half, pre-tax profit doubled to 16.0 million stg.
